title: Ring of Spiteful Thunder
summary: Damage a Reverberating creature to force a hidden save against Dazed.

fields.Spiteful Thunder: When you deal any damage to a Reverberating creature, it must make a hidden DC 13 Constitution save or become Dazed for 2 turns. The reported trigger works with damage types beyond Thunder.
fields.Dazed: Disadvantage on Wisdom saves, loses the Dexterity bonus to AC, and cannot spend Reactions. Help removes it. Reactions that do not spend the Reaction resource can still occur.
fields.Acquisition: Sold by Roah Moonglow at Moonrise Towers.

changes: Added native BG3 rules using pinned item and linked gameplay sources. Reconciled applicable action, condition, and variant details against pinned rules.
